data.name: Ki Pool
data.description: At 4th level, in addition to the normal abilities of his ki pool, a monk of the empty hand may spend 1 point from his ki pool to increase the range increment for an improvised thrown weapon or shuriken by 20 feet for 1 round.

raw_tokens.value: Monk of the Empty Hand ~ Ki Pool
